result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position because TrueLink may still assign without Client consent to a financially responsible affiliate. It also does not meet the fallback, which requires mutual successor-assignment rights with written notice. Client’s affiliate right remains unnecessarily conditioned on financial responsibility, while “reorganization,” equity sales, and the suspension/re-pricing prohibitions extend beyond the stated changes. The competitor restriction and protection against termination upon Client change of control are appropriately included, and unrelated commercial intent is generally preserved.
